parameters.query:
=INSERT INTO market_data (symbol, timeframe, ts, open, high, low, close, volume, source, dataset_version)
SELECT '{{ $json.symbol }}', '1h', x.ts::timestamptz, x.open, x.high, x.low, x.close, x.volume, 'LBank', 'v1.1-live-ingest'
FROM json_to_recordset('{{ JSON.stringify($json.rows) }}'::json) AS x(ts text, open numeric, high numeric, low numeric, close numeric, volume numeric)
ON CONFLICT (symbol, timeframe, ts, source) DO NOTHING;
=INSERT INTO agent_audit_trail (agent_id, action, reason, result) VALUES ('AGENT-01', 'DATA_INGEST', 'hourly ingest ({{ $json.symbol }})', '{{ $json.verdict }} rows={{ $json.checked }}');
